name: manual_18e3dc
claim: When harmonizing two divergent branches, use the integrative merge doctrine: synthesize never amputate. Apply resolution modes in order: additive, union, superset, synthesize, architecturally-correct, api-correct. Archive instead of delete when content must leave the active path. Never pick one side wholesale with --ours or --theirs without classifying the conflict mode first.

decisions.notes: Final Remedy 2026-07-14: Both PR #212 and PR #211 merged cleanly into corrected main using --no-ff with proper context. The orama-system integrative-merge.md reference provides the canonical six-mode resolution ladder.
